report.title: 2025 Consumer Confidence Report - Spring Valley Heights Association Inc.

sources_described: Surface Water: City of Milpitas Treated Water. Spring Valley Heights Association Inc. purchases treated water from the City of Milpitas; source-water quality is monitored by the City of Milpitas, whose Consumer Confidence Report is said to be included as an appendix (the appendix is not part of the uploaded 4-page file).
search_log: WebSearch "Spring Valley Heights" Milpitas water association consumer confidence report -> only the geoconnex/EPA SDWIS record for CA4300856 (population 63, purchased surface water); City of Milpitas CCR pages do not cover the association

https://sdwis.waterboards.ca.gov/PDWW/JSP/WaterSystemDetail.jsp?tinwsys_is_number=4292&tinwsys_st_code=CA&wsnumber=CA4300856 -> Drinking Water Watch system page; Reports section links CCR pages for 2020-2025

https://sdwis.waterboards.ca.gov/PDWW/JSP/CCR.jsp?tinwsys_is_number=4292&tinwsys_st_code=CA&Year=2025 (and Year=2024, Year=2023) -> Report + Certification links for 2025 and 2024 (2023: Report Not Available); downloaded 2025 report (PDF, 4 pages, report date June 25, 2026, covers Jan 1 - Dec 31, 2025)
